recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast studio portrait of a male figure against a deep black void, featuring a sophisticated right-aligned typographic block in white that balances the subject's central-left leaning posture.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject's warm skin tones against a cold black background
The vertical alignment of the text block mirroring the verticality of the subject
The textural contrast between the striped shirt and the flat matte background
The visual weight of the white text balancing the subject's off-center gaze
coreInvariants: Absolute black background with no visible horizon or floor
Single-source key lighting creating soft shadows on the face

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium shot, centered horizontally but leaning slightly left, occupying approximately 60% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and eyes, positioned in the upper-left quadrant.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the subject's face, down the diagonal of the arm, across to the right-aligned text block, and down to the tracklist.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Expansive black negative space surrounding the subject, used to isolate the figure and provide a canvas for the text.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Warm brown and muted lavender (Subject's skin and striped shirt)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between white text and black background; low saturation in the subject's attire to maintain a somber, soulful mood.

letterConstructionRules: Tight letter spacing for the main title
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Single typeface family used in varying weights and sizes to create hierarchy.

candidateDirections.nameOrCategory: ITC Avant Garde Gothic Extra Light
candidateDirections.reason: Captures the 1970s geometric soul aesthetic perfectly.
Provides the necessary geometric precision and thin strokes.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A studio portrait of a person with short dark hair, wearing a striped button-down shirt and a dark vest, centered against a solid, seamless black background. Lighting should be soft and directional from the upper left.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add white geometric sans-serif text in the upper right quadrant, right-aligned. Place a secondary list of text in the bottom right corner, also right-aligned and white.

verificationChecks: Is the background pure black with no texture?
Is the font weight thin enough to appear elegant rather than heavy?
Is the subject's lighting consistent with a single-source studio setup?

adjustableVariables: Vertical spacing between title and subtitle
mustRedesign: Any logos or brand-specific marks in the corners
postGenerationChecks: Check for text legibility against the black background
Ensure the subject's skin tones look natural and warm
Verify that the right-alignment of the text is crisp
Confirm the absence of any background artifacts or gradients
recipe.reuseFormula: Studio Portrait + Solid Black Background + Right-Aligned Geometric Sans-Serif Typography = Soulful Editorial Aesthetic
